Built by Toll Brothers in the highly sought-after Alara neighborhood—distinguished by its contemporary architectural design—this exceptional three-story home offers approximately 5,029 square feet of sophisticated living space, thoughtfully designed for elevated living and entertaining. From the moment you enter, a breathtaking foyer creates a memorable first impression, anchored by a stunning upgraded statement chandelier and dramatic floating staircase with upgraded railing.
